title: ST0057 prose cites six criterion ids that belong to other threads, and one of them resolves to a real green criterion about something else entirely
body:
**Driven by vc 2026-08-25 at `d5dc17aa`, with both controls passing** -- the instrument was checked against a known-present id (`AC-08.5`) and a known-absent one (`AC-10.11`) before it was believed.

**Six citations, two documents, two id families, none of them local to ST0057:**

    design.md         cites AC-02.6   -> ST0055 AND ST0056
    design.md         cites AC-10.11  -> ST0056
    design.md         cites AT-10.11  -> ST0056
    WP/08/info.md     cites AC-02.6   -> ST0055 AND ST0056
    WP/08/info.md     cites AC-10.11  -> ST0056
    WP/08/info.md     cites AT-10.11  -> ST0056

**THE SHARP ONE IS `AC-10.11`, BECAUSE IT DOES NOT DANGLE -- IT RESOLVES, TO THE WRONG THING.** `ST0057/WP/08/info.md:20` reads *Caller-assigned (`AC-10.11`, `AT-10.11`) -- `PUT` to the entity address, idempotent*, so a reader chasing the citation for the CREATION contract lands on `ST0056`'s `AC-10.11`, which is **an interrupted migration and an uninterrupted one reaching the same end state**, demonstrated by rc=137. It is real, it is `computed`, and it is about process death. **A dangling reference announces itself; a reference that resolves to a real green row about a different subject reads as coverage.**

**`AC-02.6` IS WORSE IN A DIFFERENT WAY: IT IS AMBIGUOUS ACROSS TWO THREADS.** Both `ST0055` and `ST0056` carry an `AC-02.6`, so the citation does not identify a criterion even after you go looking. **This half was already known** -- vc's board carries *`AC-02.6`'s SECOND JOB is uncovered: `design.md:270` assigns the GET/PUT round trip to a criterion that lives in ST0056 and is green on its FIRST job only* -- **but it was carried as one incident. It is a class, and this is its second family.**

**WHY THE GATE CANNOT SEE ANY OF IT.** `ac gate ST0057` reads canon ROWS. A criterion id appearing in PROSE is not a row and is invisible to every instrument the thread owns. So **ST0057's gate PASSes at 51/51 while its own WP-08 body points its two create-contracts at another thread.**

**AND IT BLOCKS A WP CLOSE RIGHT NOW.** `ST0057/WP-08` is WIP with 5/5 criteria PASS, which looks like an unflipped bit. It is not. Its own enumerated-gap table names `Criterion create: missing` and `AcceptanceTest create: missing`, **driven and confirmed tonight rather than grepped: `intent3 ac --help` lists nine subcommands and `at --help` five, and NOT ONE of the fourteen creates anything** -- every arm is a transition on a row that already exists. `AC-08.5` covers *every writable FIELD*, and **creation is not a field**, so no ST0057 criterion covers either gap and the two that WP-08 nominates are foreign.

**This is the estate's live absence class arriving as a coverage hole rather than as a measurement error:** *no CLI verb CREATES an AC or an AT*, demonstrated again the same evening when `AC-14.12` reached canon by a hand-edit plus `sync --to-store`.

**Remedy is not obvious and is NOT vc's alone, because minting coverage changes a denominator.** At least three shapes, all needing hv:

1. **A citation to a foreign thread is written `ST0056/AC-10.11`, never bare** -- makes the class visible on sight and makes it greppable. Cheapest, and it fixes nothing about coverage.
2. **Mint ST0057 criteria for the two create-gaps** -- honest coverage, moves 51/51 to 51/53 and re-opens a gate that currently PASSes.
3. **Record that the create-contracts are ST0056's to carry** and cite them explicitly as such, leaving ST0057's denominator alone.

**Reporting `PASS` over an uncovered stated deliverable is what is not acceptable; which of the three closes it is hv's.**
